title: [GMCP 203.038.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Catalog, discovery, health, compatibility, and trust intelligence
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-038-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Local configs, running processes, package managers, the official registry and explicit endpoints reconcile into one deduplicated catalog with provenance. Active probes measure protocol/extension compatibility, health, latency and policy fitness without granting trust; recommendations explain evidence and cost; stale or conflicting records converge; and discovery never installs, enables or sends data without authorization. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
